Javad Qarai, a documentary filmmaker and nature enthusiast, posted a video on his Instagram account on Monday, 27 Mehr, showing the rescue operation for Iranian fighter jet pilots after they crashed during the 40-day war. He says he beeped over the pilot's voice to keep him unidentified. This documentary filmmaker says he went with a helicopter and several people to the central Alborz mountains to rescue two "Yak-130" fighter jet pilots who were targeted in an Israeli attack on 13 Esfand 1404. He stated the rescue area as "Afjeh to Dasht-e Lar." The Iranian "Yak-130" fighter jet, which had taken off to counter Israeli F-35s, was targeted and its pilots ejected and landed in the Lavasan mountains. The Israeli Defense Forces published the news and video of this incident on 13 and 14 Esfand 1404.radiofarda@mamlekate
